MOLECULAR ONCOLOGY REPORT
[redacted location] Cancer Center
Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Sex: Male
Ordering Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Diagnosis: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
Specimen Site: Acetabular lesion
Specimen Type: Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue
Tumor Content: 20%

TEST PERFORMED
Comprehensive Oncology Panel - DNA and RNA Analysis

METHODOLOGY
This comprehensive oncology assay utilizes molecular barcoded primer technology with an integrated sequencer platform. DNA and RNA were extracted from FFPE tissue using automated extraction kits. The assay interrogates 45 genes for DNA variants including single nucleotide variants (SNVs), insertions/deletions (indels), and splicing alterations, and 17 fusion kinase genes for RNA fusions and oncogenic isoforms. The analytical sensitivity is ≥5% variant allele frequency with a minimum coverage depth of 100×.

DNA PANEL RESULTS

Gene	Exons Tested	Result	Coverage
EGFR	18-21	No variants detected	245×
KRAS	2-4 (codons 12, 13, 59, 61, 117, 146)	No variants detected	312×
BRAF	11, 15	No variants detected	289×

Additional genes tested (partial list): AKT1, ALK, APC, ATM, CDH1, CDKN2A, CSF1R, CTNNB1, ERBB2, ERBB4, ESR1, FBXW7, FGFR1, FGFR2, FGFR3, FLT3, GNA11, GNAQ, GNAS, HNF1A, HRAS, IDH1, IDH2, JAK2, JAK3, KIT, MAP2K1, MET, MLH1, MPL, NOTCH1, NPM1, NRAS, PDGFRA, PIK3CA, PTEN, PTPN11, RB1, SMAD4, SMARCB1, SMO, SRC, STK11, TP53, TSC1, VHL

RNA FUSION PANEL RESULTS

Gene	Fusion/Alteration Tested	Result
ALK	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected
ROS1	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected
RET	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected
MET	Exon 14 skipping	Not detected
NTRK1	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected
NTRK2	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected
NTRK3	Fusions with multiple partners	Not detected

Additional fusion genes tested: BRAF, EGFR, ERBB2, ESR1, FGFR1, FGFR2, FGFR3, PDGFRA, PPARG, RAF1

QUALITY METRICS
DNA Input: 50 ng
RNA Input: 40 ng
Mean Coverage Depth: 278×
Uniformity (>0.2× mean): 98.5%
On-Target Rate: 96.2%

INTERPRETATION
No clinically actionable variants were identified in this comprehensive molecular profiling analysis. Specifically:

1. DNA analysis revealed no variants in EGFR (exons 18-21), KRAS (codons 12, 13, 59, 61, 117, 146), or BRAF (V600), indicating this tumor is unlikely to respond to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (e.g., erlotinib, gefitinib, osimertinib), MEK inhibitors, or BRAF inhibitors.

2. RNA analysis did not detect fusions involving ALK, ROS1, RET, MET, or NTRK1/2/3, nor MET exon 14 skipping alterations. Therefore, the patient is unlikely to benefit from targeted therapies directed against these alterations, including ALK inhibitors (e.g., alectinib, crizotinib), ROS1 inhibitors (e.g., crizotinib, entrectinib), RET inhibitors (e.g., selpercatinib), MET inhibitors (e.g., capmatinib, tepotinib), or NTRK inhibitors (e.g., larotrectinib, entrectinib).

LIMITATIONS
• This assay has a limit of detection of ≥5% variant allele frequency
• Low tumor content may affect sensitivity
• Not all exons of all genes are covered
• Complex structural variants may not be detected
• Results should be interpreted in conjunction with clinical and pathological findings

Electronically signed by: Dr. [redacted name], MD, PhD
Board Certified in Molecular Genetic Pathology
